name: Chile Lime Cucumber Avocado Salad
desc: Thin Persian cucumbers, avocado, shallot, cilantro, pistachios and feta shaken with lime and chile lime seasoning.

source.title: Chile Lime Cucumber Avocado Salad
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 large shallot (or 1/3 red onion), finely diced
1/2 cup fresh cilantro (1 large handful), finely chopped, plus more for topping
ingredients.prep: finely chopped, plus more for topping

ingredients.raw: 1 oz feta cheese, crumbled, plus more for topping
1/2-1 tbsp chile lime seasoning (such as Tajín)

steps: Cut the cucumbers thin into half moons, coins or sticks and put them in a large jar or bowl.
Add the avocado, shallot, cilantro and pistachios.
Top with the feta, lime zest and juice, olive oil, salt and chile lime seasoning.
Put the lid on and give it a good shake, or toss gently in the bowl.
Finish with more feta and chopped cilantro.
tips: Keep the cucumbers thin so they soak up more dressing.
Good with grilled chicken, shrimp or steak.
